## Feature Description

A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Use Case

Describe the problem this feature would solve or the workflow it would improve.

**Example scenario:**
> As a [role], I want [feature] so that [benefit].

## Proposed Solution

How would you like this feature to work?

```typescript
// Example API usage (if applicable)
{
  "op": "new.operation",
  "d": {
    // ...
  }
}
```

## Alternatives Considered

What alternatives have you considered? Why is this approach better?

## Impact

- Who would benefit from this feature?
- How often would it be used?
- Would it require breaking changes?

## Additional Context

Any mockups, diagrams, or examples that help explain the feature.

## Implementation Notes

If you're willing to contribute, outline how you'd approach implementing this.
